import sys

def process(is_stream, os_stream):
    line = is_stream.readline().rstrip('\n')
    count = 0
    start = 0
    while start < len(line):
        end = start
        current = line[start]
        while end < len(line) and line[end] == current:
            end += 1
        length = end - start
        count += (length + 1) % 2
        start = end
    os_stream.write(str(count) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    process(sys.stdin, sys.stdout)
